nota: Pursuit (Universidade de Melbourne, 17/01/2017), a tabela do estudo: 'Creature Deaths (2000-2013) Hospitalisations (2001-2013) … Spiders 0 11,994'; e 'There were no spider bite fatalities.' O texto diz que o estudo leu os dados 'from August 2001 to May 2013', e o resumo do IMJ, 'over the 11 years': 'a little more than a decade' na voz está certo, e o '13 YEARS' segue proibido. DF-04: os ≈ 12,000 só com o zero de Welton e 'ONE STUDY', nunca no quadro do zero do ABS. ATENÇÃO (a mesma página): 'A man died from a red back spider bite in April 2016, the first spider bite death in more than 30 years, however this was outside the study period.' É de s58 (o redback): ver lá.

texto_aprovado: Spiders don't appear at all: not one death, in any of those years. It isn't that spiders don't bite. Over a little more than a decade, one study found, spider bites put Australians in the hospital about 12,000 times. None of those bites killed anyone.
